verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing states it identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files, which covers diarization. A replit example that queries questions from participants outside the organization hints that speakers are tied to participant identity, but no evidence explicitly shows transcript lines matched to real named speakers rather than generic labels. Missing for 10: documented mapping of speakers to real participant names, details on name-matching accuracy or correction, hands-on or independent corroboration of attribution quality.
